doubts: The Fern Burn carpark start is taken as F1 (where Motatapu Track meets Motatapu Road); the text only says the carpark is signposted on the Matukituki Valley road after turning off at Glendhu Bay. Arrowtown has no road-end feature, so the end is null. The track can be accessed from either end; recorded in the described direction. Between Roses Hut and Macetown there are two options (following the Arrow River, or a sidling track and water race if the river is high); both lead to Macetown. W2 is the Big Hill Track alternative for the last section (its 4-5 hr covers only that section); 'Big Hill Track' may be the map's Big Hill Walkway (T1) but the names differ, so no ref.
